Label: AdministrativeArea
Description: A geographical region under the jurisdiction of a particular government. Declared in the schema but not populated in the current release.

Label: Audience
Description: Intended audience for an item, i.e. the group for whom the item was created. Declared in the schema but not populated in the current release.

Label: CategoryCode
Description: A category code from a controlled vocabulary or taxonomy.

Label: ContactPoint
Description: A contact point for a person or organization.

Label: OpeningHoursSpecification
Description: A structured value providing information about the opening hours of a place or service. Declared in the schema but not populated in the current release.

Label: Organization
Description: An organization such as a school, NGO, corporation, club, etc. Declared in the schema but not populated in the current release.

Label: Place
Description: Entities that have a somewhat fixed, physical extension.

Label: Rating
Description: A numeric or qualitative rating of an item. Rating nodes carry no value of their own; the numeric rating is schema:ratingValue on the service.

Label: Review
Description: A review of an item such as a service, organization, or resource. Reviews carry a text and a rating node, but nothing links a review to the service it is about in this release.

Label: Service
Description: A service provided by an organization or individual.

Label: ServiceChannel
Description: A means for accessing a service, e.g. a phone number, website, or physical location.

Label: TextObject
Description: A text file, including articles, speeches, presentations, etc.

Label: Geometry
Description: A coherent set of direct positions in space (GeoSPARQL); here the point geometry of a place, read through geo:asWKT.

Label: address
Description: Physical address of the item.

Label: areaServed
Description: The geographic area where a service or offered item is provided.

Label: audienceType
Description: The target group associated with a given audience (e.g., veterans, car owners, musicians). Declared in the schema but not populated in the current release.

Label: availableChannel
Description: A means of accessing the service (e.g. a phone bank, a web site, a location).

Label: category
Description: A category for the item. Besides typed category codes (service types, languages, availability, cost), services point to audience and service_type category IRIs that carry no rdf:type.

Label: closes
Description: The closing hour of the place or service on the given day(s) of the week. Declared in the schema but not populated in the current release.

Label: codeValue
Description: A short textual code that uniquely identifies the value.

Label: conditionsOfAccess
Description: Conditions that affect the availability of, or method(s) of access to, an item.

Label: containedInPlace
Description: The basic containment relation between a place and one that contains it. Here the containing place is a KnowWhereGraph ZIP code area IRI (kwg resource zipCodeArea.<zip>).

Label: dayOfWeek
Description: The day of the week for which these opening hours are valid. Declared in the schema but not populated in the current release.

Label: description
Description: A description of the item.

Label: disambiguatingDescription
Description: A sub property of description providing a short description to disambiguate instances with similar names.

Label: hasMap
Description: A URL to a map of the place.

Label: hoursAvailable
Description: The hours during which this service or contact is available. Declared in the schema but not populated in the current release.

Label: identifier
Description: The identifier property represents any kind of identifier for any kind of Thing.

Label: inCodeSet
Description: A CategoryCodeSet that contains this category code. The code sets are five named individuals (services main and other, languages, availability, cost).

Label: latitude
Description: The latitude of a location.

Label: longitude
Description: The longitude of a location.

Label: name
Description: The name of the item.

Label: openingHours
Description: The opening hours of a service. Here the object is a node per service and weekday whose text is read through the xmlschema11-2#time predicate, not a literal.

Label: opens
Description: The opening hour of the place or service on the given day(s) of the week. Declared in the schema but not populated in the current release.

Label: Postal Code
Description: The postal code of an address.

Label: provider
Description: The service provider, service operator, or service performer. Each service has its own provider IRI, which carries no rdf:type and no properties in this release.

Label: Rating Value
Description: The numeric value of a rating.

Label: Review Body
Description: The textual content of a review.

Label: Review Rating
Description: The rating given as part of a review.

Label: sameAs
Description: URL of a reference Web page that unambiguously indicates the item's identity. Here mostly Facebook and Twitter pages of the service; some values are the string None.

Label: serviceLocation
Description: The location where the service is provided.

Label: servicePhone
Description: The phone number to use to access the service.

Label: serviceUrl
Description: The website to access the service.

Label: telephone
Description: The telephone number.

Label: text
Description: The textual content of this CreativeWork.

Label: URL
Description: The URL of the item. Declared in the schema but not populated in the current release.

Label: sfWithin
Description: Indicates that a place is spatially within a KnowWhereGraph ZIP code area (kwg resource zipCodeArea.<zip>); the join key to other spatial graphs.

Label: asWKT
Description: The Well-Known Text serialization of a geometry, here a point such as POINT(-118.222463 33.792303) in longitude latitude order.

Label: defaultGeometry
Description: The default geometry to be used in spatial calculations; here the same point geometry as geo:hasGeometry.

Label: hasGeometry
Description: A spatial representation for a given feature; links a place to its point geometry.

Label: type
Description: The subject is an instance of a class.

Label: exactMatch
Description: Links a language category code to the matching ISO 639-3 language in Lexvo (lexvo.org/id/iso639-3/).

Label: time
Description: Opening hours of a service for one weekday as text (e.g., Friday from 00:00 to 23:59), on the node that schema:openingHours points to. The predicate IRI is the XML Schema time datatype used as a property.
